[SWS_DM_00268] EcuReset positive response processing before reset
⌈
If the external processor did NOT raise an ApApplicationError, the Diagnos-
tic Server instance shall return a positive response before the actual reset, in
case the parameter DiagnosticEcuResetClass.respondToReset is either not
present or present and set to DiagnosticResponseToEcuResetEnum.respond-
BeforeReset.
